messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Technology promised a new world, more at least than what was being offered my heart.

output.original_text: Technology promised a new world, more at least than what was being offered my heart.
output.joy: Technology promised a new world, so much more than what my heart could have hoped for!
output.sadness: Technology promised a new world, far more than what my heart was ever offered.
output.fear: Technology promised a new world, yet I fear it may be more than what my heart can handle.
output.anger: Technology promised a new world, but it’s still so much more than what my heart has ever received!
output.surprise: Technology promised a new world, more than I ever thought my heart could be offered!
output.disgust: Technology promised a new world, more than the empty gestures my heart has been fed.
